decisions.reason: As a platform product line central to the firm's announced integrated solutions, its high prior investment and public commitment make withdrawal unlikely despite any disappointing results.
The mobile field data capture software has its own page and moderate visibility, and escalation of commitment leads management to continue the product rather than admit failure.
Although the search extension is less central and more incremental, it has remained on the market since 2018 and management continues to justify its earlier commitment.
